query.statement: SELECT ALARM_CLASS_ID, ALARM_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM COM_ALARM_CLASS ORDER BY ALARM_CLASS_NAME
SELECT ALARM_ID, ALARM_NAME, ALARM_CLASS_ID, SEVERITY, MESSAGE, IS_ACTIVE FROM COM_ALARM WHERE (@alarmClassId IS NULL OR ALARM_CLASS_ID = @alarmClassId) ORDER BY ALARM_NAME
SELECT MODEL_ID, MODEL_NAME, TARGET_ENTITY, DESCRIPTION FROM COM_STATE_MODEL ORDER BY MODEL_NAME
SELECT STATE_ID, MODEL_ID, STATE_NAME, STATE_CODE, SORT_ORDER, IS_INITIAL FROM COM_STATE WHERE (@modelId IS NULL OR MODEL_ID = @modelId) ORDER BY MODEL_ID, SORT_ORDER
SELECT LABEL_ID, LABEL_NAME, LABEL_TYPE, IS_ACTIVE FROM COM_LABEL ORDER BY LABEL_NAME
SELECT RULE_ID, RULE_NAME, PREFIX, SEQ_LENGTH, CURRENT_SEQ, RESET_CYCLE, DESCRIPTION FROM COM_ID_RULE ORDER BY RULE_NAME
SELECT SERVER_ID, SERVER_NAME, HOST, PORT, SENDER_ADDRESS, USE_SSL, IS_ACTIVE FROM COM_MAIL_SERVER ORDER BY SERVER_NAME
SELECT RECIPIENT_ID, PLANT_ID, USER_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, MAIL_ADDRESS, MAIL_TYPE, IS_ACTIVE FROM COM_MAIL_RECIPIENT WHERE MAIL_TYPE = 'Mail' ORDER BY USER_ID
SELECT RECIPIENT_ID, PLANT_ID, USER_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, MAIL_ADDRESS, MAIL_TYPE, IS_ACTIVE FROM COM_MAIL_RECIPIENT WHERE MAIL_TYPE = 'Alarm' ORDER BY USER_ID
SELECT SERVICE_ID, SERVICE_NAME, SERVICE_TYPE, STATUS, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM COM_SERVICE ORDER BY SERVICE_NAME

SELECT ACTION_ID, ACTION_NAME, ACTION_TYPE, HOLD_CODE, EMAIL_TITLE, SMS_TITLE, PROCEDURE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM COM_ACTION WHERE (@actionType IS NULL OR ACTION_TYPE = @actionType) ORDER BY ACTION_NAME
SELECT ALARM_ACTION_ID, ALARM_ID, ACTION_ID, ACTION_SEQUENCE, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM COM_ALARM_ACTION WHERE (@alarmId IS NULL OR ALARM_ID = @alarmId) ORDER BY ALARM_ID, ACTION_SEQUENCE

INSERT INTO COM_ACTION (ACTION_ID, ACTION_NAME, ACTION_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@actionId, @actionName, @actionType, @description, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow)
